meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找 UI 样式、配色、字体和动效参考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在设计或评审网页和移动端 UI 时需要灵感与规范参考。
copy.tagline_en: Find UI styles, color palettes, fonts, and motion references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need inspiration and guidelines when designing or reviewing UI for web and mobile.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询内置的 UI/UX 规则库，根据你的需求返回风格、颜色、字体等设计建议，并生成设计系统文档。
howto.when: 当你需要设计、构建或审查网页或移动端 UI，包括页面、组件、配色、排版、布局、无障碍、动画或数据可视化时触发。

say.text: 为一个健康管理App设计配色方案。
say.note: Claude 会运行搜索脚本返回推荐的调色板。

say.text: 检查这个登录页面的无障碍问题。
say.note: Claude 会依据内置UX规则给出改进建议。

say.text: 给一个电子商务首页推荐字体配对。
say.note: Claude 会查询字体配对库并返回推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query a built-in UI/UX rule database to return design recommendations for styles, colors, fonts, etc., and generate a design system document based on your needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design, build, or review web or mobile UI, including pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

say_en.text: Suggest a color palette for a health tracking app.
say_en.note: Claude runs the search script and returns palette suggestions.

say_en.text: Audit this landing page for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude uses built-in UX rules to provide improvements.

say_en.text: Recommend font pairings for an e-commerce homepage.
say_en.note: Claude queries the font pairing database and returns options.
